title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Cover image: A group of scimitar-horned oryx (Oryx dammah) is released into the Réserve de Faune de Ouadi Rimé-Ouadi Achim (RFOROA), Chad. The Oryx Reintroduction Project in Chad is a joint initiative of the Government of Chad and the Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi, with on-the-ground implementation carried out by Sahara Conservation. Post-release monitoring using animal tracking technology and direct observations enables researchers to assess disease status using hidden Markov models (HMMs) applied to movement data. Full details are available in the article by Kim et al., https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2664.70323.
